content.title: Earnings Announcement Timing and Investor Reactions in Volatile Markets
content.abstract: Earnings announcements are scheduled information events, yet both the moment at which the news reaches the market and the market conditions prevailing at that moment can shape investor responses. This paper examines how two dimensions of announcement timing—the trading session in which the news is first priced (before the open versus after the close) and the position of the announcement within the reporting season—interact with market-wide volatility.
